items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: Their own quintet, that Jazz Workshop with “This Here,” the Bobby Timmon song and San Francisco.

ctx.x: Their own quintet, that Jazz Workshop with “This Here,” the Bobby Timmon song and San Francisco. Through the end of the second quartet, or the second sextet, when he had — what is it, that sextet he had with Yusef — did you ever hear that group?
